plate_comment: The watchdog fueling monitor (e2m 8A70, fault 388 Watchdog_Fueling_Error 'fueling is high when it should not be'): with nothing demanding fuel (no TSC1 speed / torque control, power take-off governor, cruise, commanded throttle or accelerator off idle) and average_engine_speed above watchdog_fueling_minimum_engine_speed, the pilot + main + auxiliary on-time minus the per-event offsets above watchdog_fueling_duration_threshold + the coolant allowance for watchdog_fueling_error_debounce_limit passes sets fault 388 and logical output request 54 (was fuel_quantity_demand_monitor) | earlier note: Excess-injection monitor (fault 388, P0606: an internal fault with no component DTC): sums the pilot / main / auxiliary injection on-times minus fuel_demand_active_correction_increment per active event and compares the sum with DAT_0040894c plus fuel_quantity_demand_excess_cold_allowance (coolant temperature table) while nothing demands fuel (no TSC1 override mode 1 / 2, governor fuel, cruise, computed driver demand or accelerator off-idle) and engine speed is above DAT_00408950; after DAT_0040894e passes in a row it sets fault 388 and logical output request 54. fuel_quantity_demand_initialize is the only clear (name kept).
Clears fault 388 (detected and registered), logical output request 54 and the coolant allowance lookup cache (2) (was fuel_quantity_demand_initialize)
